intro.title: FUNDA — Auto-save Draft Widget
intro.body: In this lesson you will build an Auto-save Draft Widget — a text editor form that silently saves the user's content to the server every time they pause typing, displaying a status indicator (Saving… → Saved ✓ → Error ✗) without an explicit save button. You will tap the FormControl's valueChanges stream, debounce it, and use concatMap to queue save requests so they never run out of order. The widget uses an optimistic UI pattern — local state updates immediately while the network call is in flight, rolling back on failure.
intro.usecase: Auto-save is a foundational feature of modern productivity tools — Google Docs, Notion, Confluence, and GitHub Issues. concatMap prevents out-of-order saves; mergeMap would fire parallel requests that could arrive out of order.
